entries.reason: the list form is MusicDeviceMIDIEventList, which iOS 6.1.3's AudioToolbox does not export: its four MusicDevice exports are MusicDeviceMIDIEvent, MusicDeviceStartNote, MusicDeviceStopNote and MusicDeviceSysEx
entries.effect: calling it would raise an unrecognised selector, which is what the registry's absent means; the single-event and system-exclusive forms are both carried and work
